action_items: Fix ProtectedRoute for /leaves so every authenticated employee can access it. Recommended: drop the moduleKey='leaves' guard on the /leaves route in /app/frontend/src/App.js (leave management is self-service, similar to a personal profile), OR make sure the tenant-config seed grants view permission on the 'leaves' module to every role (not just Admin/CEO/managers). After that, retest the full non-admin (creative.director@nylaairwater.earth) flow specified in the review.
Nice-to-have: the delete dialog uses AlertDialog inside the page — verify keyboard focus is trapped.
critical_code_review_comments: LeaveManagement.js — role check for showing Team Requests uses `isManager` (['ceo','director','vp','admin','sales_manager']) but the trash icon separately uses `isAdmin` (['admin','ceo','system admin','system_admin']). Consistent single source of truth would be safer.

LeaveBalancePanel: `pct` uses `sc.annual + sc.carry_forward || 1` — operator precedence makes the fallback apply only when carry_forward is 0 AND annual is 0. Works today (annual=18) but is fragile; wrap in parentheses: `((sc.annual + sc.carry_forward) || 1)`.

Frontend workingDays helper duplicates backend logic and does not consume the user's fixed_holiday_dates when computing days for over-balance UI — passing holidayDates=[] means Sundays skipped but city holidays counted client-side. Server enforces the correct count, but the 'Remaining after this request' hint may briefly mismatch server value for date ranges spanning city fixed holidays.

leave_policy.py compute_balance uses `today.month if year == today.year else (12 if year < today.year else 0)` — 'else 0' is a typo (should be 12 for past years, 0 for future). Currently works because year defaults to today.year; still worth flipping the branches.
